      (GrpCat.ofHom (FundamentalGroup.map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal A) ⟨x, hxA⟩))
      (GrpCat.ofHom (FundamentalGroup.map (ContinuousMap.subtypeVal B) ⟨x, hxB⟩)) := by
